text:
Jaime: Kicking off a config-only deploy (cfg-20260321-11). Targets: routing weight smoothing, tighter request timeout, smaller batching window, soft concurrency floor. Change window 23:00-00:00 UTC. @DeployBot please start 2% smoke across EU region :eyes:

DeployBot: [deploybot] start: cfg-20260321-11 -> config-only -> strategy: gradual-weight(2%->10%->100%) over 30m. Canary group: 2% traffic to egress-routing-slim. Rollback thresholds: error_rate > 0.5% OR p99_latency +50ms. Metrics hooks enabled.

Jaime: snippet of the config being applied:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  smooth_weight_alpha: 0.97
  fallback_model: v1.4.3
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 3500
  stream_idle_ms: 12000
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  batch_window_ms: 12
limits:
  concurrency_per_model: 80
  tenant_qps_floor: 2
```

Mina: Ack. I'll watch p95/p99 and 5xx rate on the canary tenants. Deploying just config keys so expect no model reloads.

DeployBot: Canary step 1 applied -> 2% traffic. Metrics snapshot (canary): error_rate 0.12% -> +0.02pt, p99 128ms -> +8ms, cpu 62% stable. No spikes in file-descriptor errors.

SRE-Jen: Infra looks fine from my side, no obvious node OOMs or host-level throttling. KV cache hit-rates steady.

Liam: Request: can we pin the top 3 high-qps tenants to v1.4.3 during the rollout? They tend to amplify tail latency when model switching occurs.

Jaime: Good call. Pinning high-qps tenants (tenant ids: T-109, T-214, T-330) to v1.4.3 for the next 2 hours while we graduate the rest. This is a config-only pin, no code change.

Mina: Noted. Watching error_rate and routing mismatches. If we see error_rate > 0.5% or p99 jump >50ms I'll call rollback.

Liam: Rollback command for quick action: `/deploy rollback cfg-20260321-11 --immediate` Keep it handy.

DeployBot: Canary step 2 -> 10% traffic scheduled in 10m. No immediate alerts. Sending annotated diffs to release-notes channel.

Mina: Quick check: can someone confirm observability alerts are set to page at 5xx rate +0.3% (to avoid noisy pages)? We want an SRE page only for meaningful regressions.

SRE-Jen: Alerts adjusted: canary-5xx-high set to 0.3% absolute, canary-p99-delta set to +40ms. Pager if both fire.

Ops-Bot: Scheduled reminder posted to #eng-releases at 23:05 UTC. Will post final status at 23:30 UTC. :calendar:

Jaime: Thanks everyone. If after 30m metrics look stable we proceed to global ramp. If not, rollback immediately and escalate. Keep messages here short and only post action items. :shipit:
